item.title: Eileen Gu ’26 wins Olympic silver with more events to come
item.description: Stanford’s own Eileen Gu ’26 secured her fourth Olympic medal on Monday, earning silver in the women’s freeski slopestyle event. The post Eileen Gu ’26 wins Olympic silver with more events to come appeared first on The Stanford Daily.
